purpose: Document first-party Pilibhit/Uttar Pradesh registry discovery, public route attempts, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official Pilibhit District Administration evidence identifies Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh as the district land-record service. The current public UP Bhunaksha application was inspected for configuration and anonymous endpoints; district 151, Pilibhit tehsil code 00790, and village metadata were returned. An exact-point lookup at [28.6241383152122, 79.8085612096802] returned {}, so no safe anonymous ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Pilibhit District Administration land-record page and UP Revenue Board page. This is local service custody plus a state cadastral-map route; it is not source integration, ownership evidence, or proof of citywide parcel availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Pilibhit district page says the UP Bhulekh portal computerizes land records and is implemented in all state tehsils; it links the state service.
Official UP Revenue Board page lists Bhulekh/Bhunaksha (भू-नक्शा / शजरा), including village maps and gata-boundary viewing.
Official public Bhunaksha viewer loaded and its current JavaScript identified the API base https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and anonymous map/metadata methods.
Official UP dashboard reports Pilibhit district cadastral-map digitization, including a Pilibhit tehsil row with 262 scanned/verified/linked mapsheets and 230 georeferenced mapsheets.
Official Government of India DILRMP page reports Pilibhit district land-record computerization status, including Pilibhit tehsil totals; this is progress evidence, not a parcel feature endpoint.
